title: Whitley Strieber's traumatic abduction, which he calls a communion

tellings.quote: take Whitley Strieber as an example who said he was raped anally and to this day decades later he puts ointment on to uh cover the uh wounds he experienced but at the end of the day he says it was a communion.

plain: The author Whitley Strieber is said to have been abducted by non-human beings in the 1980s and anally raped, and to still put ointment on the wounds decades later, yet he calls the experience a communion. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove tells Michels this, using Strieber as an example. He tells it to show how such encounters can be both terrifying and, for those who live through them, deeply meaningful.
